    • rocketPositions

      private final Map<String,Pair<Double,Double>> rocketPositions
      A map that holds predefined positions of rockets for different levels of a game board. Each position is represented by a unique key and associated with a pair of coordinates (X, Y), where the X-coordinate represents the horizontal position and the Y-coordinate represents the vertical position.

    • placePlayerInBoard

      public void placePlayerInBoard(String playerNickname, int difficultyLevel, int boardSize, javafx.scene.layout.Pane gameBoardPane, Map<String,javafx.scene.image.ImageView> playersRocketBoard)
      Places a player's rocket on the game board. If the player's rocket is already present on the board, its position is updated based on the player's current cursor and the game's difficulty level.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - The nickname of the player whose rocket is to be placed or updated on the board.
      difficultyLevel - The current difficulty level of the game, which determines the game board configuration.
      boardSize - The total number of cells on the board, determining the wrapping behavior of player positions.
      gameBoardPane - The container (Pane) representing the game board where the player's rocket is positioned.
      playersRocketBoard - A map that stores the association between player nicknames and their rockets (ImageView objects) on the board.

    • removePlayerFromBoard

      gameBoardPane - The container (Pane) representing the game board where the player's rocket is positioned.
      playersRocketBoard - A map that stores the association between player nicknames and their rockets (ImageView objects) on the board.

    • revertVisuals

      public <T> void revertVisuals(javafx.scene.layout.GridPane shipGrid, Map<String,javafx.scene.layout.FlowPane> emptiedIcons, Map<String,javafx.scene.layout.Region> emptiedRegions, Map<String,javafx.scene.layout.Region> currentRegions, Class<T> castType, BiConsumer<T,javafx.scene.layout.FlowPane> initIcons)
      Restores the visual state of the ship grid, including icons and regions, based on the emptiedIcons and the emptiedRegions, using the passed function
      Parameters:
      shipGrid - The gridPane representing the ship grid where visuals should be restored.
      emptiedIcons - A map containing keys associated with FlowPane objects that were previously removed.
      emptiedRegions - A map containing keys associated with Region objects that were previously removed.
      currentRegions - A map representing the regions in which to add the regions to restore
      castType - The class type used to cast ship components during restoration.
      initIcons - A function used to initialize the icons for specific components in the grid. Accepts a type parameter T and a FlowPane for the initialization logic.
